Name: Sibbecai the Hushathite
Summary: Valient man of David's armies, who slew Sippai of the children of the giant, and captain of the eighth month's course.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 11:29; 1 Chronicles 27:11: Valient man of David's armies, who slew Sippai of the children of the giant, and captain of the eighth month's course.
LifeLesson: The mention of Sibbecai in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
